positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: West Henrietta, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed high-performance Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, delivering responsive, declarative UI designs for seamless user experiences across diverse device ecosystems.
 • Architected scalable app structures with MVVM and Clean Architecture principles, leveraging Hilt for dependency injection to ensure modular, testable, and maintainable codebases.
 • Optimized app performance by integrating Jetpack libraries (Room, WorkManager, Navigation) and Kotlin Coroutines/Flow for efficient data persistence, background processing, and reactive programming.
 • Implemented password-less login using AWS Console to integrate one-time passcode (OTP) authentication with Amazon Cognito, enhancing user security and streamlining login flows.
 • Implemented accessibility best practices using Androids Accessibility Scanner and TalkBack, ensuring apps meet WCAG standards for inclusive user access.
 • Spearheaded end-to-end Android app development from scratch as the sole Android developer, designing and implementing all features, architecture, and integrations.
